# [TASK] Add custom avatar upload workflow and live preview on Profile screen

## Task
Implement a custom profile photo uploader in the React frontend (`frontend/lmdb`) on the User Profile screen, enabling users to upload personalized avatars directly to the backend media-service.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] File selector unit allows image uploading (JPG/PNG, size validation < 5MB) on the Profile screen (`Profile.test.jsx`: `displays validation error when uploading a non-image format file`, `displays validation error when uploading an image larger than 5MB`)
- [x] API client calls `POST /api/v1/media/upload` with `entityType=USER` and `mediaType=AVATAR` (`Profile.jsx` `handleFileChange`; `Profile.test.jsx`: `successfully uploads valid JPG avatar and shows success notification`)
- [x] Displayed user avatar across the navigation bar and profile page reflects the uploaded thumbnail URL from MongoDB/MinIO (`Profile.test.jsx`: `renders uploaded avatar thumbnail when media items are returned`; `NavBar.test.jsx`: `displays uploaded custom avatar thumbnail image when present in media list`)
- [x] Unit/DOM tests cover file selection, validation error states, and preview rendering (`npx vitest run src/components/Profile/Profile.test.jsx src/components/NavBar/NavBar.test.jsx`, 18 tests)

## Estimate
Hours: 10

## Notes
Verified via Vitest tests in `Profile.test.jsx` and `NavBar.test.jsx` (18/18 passing this run).
